newsitem.title: USA: Fed adds reserves via 3-day fixed system RPs.
newsitem.headline: Fed adds reserves via 3-day fixed system RPs.

text.p: The Federal Reserve injected reserves into the banking system on Monday through a round of three-day fixed system repurchase agreements, the New York Fed confirmed.
The operation was expected, as analysts projected the Fed faces around a $4.5 billion a day add need for the remaining three days of the maintenance period.
Federal funds were trading at 5-9/16 percent, above the 5-1/2 percent target rate, when the Fed entered the open market.
